bio: Earthy shades, Moorish motifs and rattan pendant lights exude Middle Eastern warmth. The room sports two dining vibes: a friendly bar at the front or views of the open kitchen to the rear. The chefs put a contemporary spin on Arabic cuisine from hummus, kebab and falafel to whole roast chicken and grilled seabass. Alternatively, order ‘Feed Me’ and let the chefs decide. Come with a posse to share the food and the fun....
